title: Has anyone else seen this in their mall world?
content: There are eerie things that I can relate to that others have said, and I saw one video of someone talking about the ground floor. She said not to go there and that there were mannequin type people with no face. Well maybe five years ago when I had never heard of the mall world conspiracy, I had a vivid dream that mall world was kind of like purgatory or some sort of testing ground. I remember I finally escaped through using Jesus’s name, but as I was leaving it seemed that God showed me something. Not vividly but he let me know that ground floor was pretty much a hell with demons and many lost souls who were led down there by being tempted to have group sex and eventually were SAd by demons. All other horrors you can think of were at ground level too, it was a hell. Did anyone see this in their dream? Also I’ve escaped the mall twice but it was like escaping with demon zombies hunting me down, one kept trying to inject me tranquillizing or psychiatric drugs but I escaped. Whew…
